project.title: Aalborg West wastewater treatment plant metagenome sequencing, assembly and metatranscriptomics
project.description: This project encompasses data from the Glomicave project, recovery of high-quality metagenome-assembled genomes from specific wastewater treatment plant for multi-omics data analysis. The project is funded by the Glomicave project. The associated sample metagenomes are from Aalborg West, Danish wastewater treatment plant. Project includes datasets with 214 high quality metagenome assembled genomes and metatranscriptomics from 179 samples (39 samples from full-scale Aalborg West wastewater treatment plant and 140 samples from batch experiments). All the raw data for metagenomics and metatranscriptomics analysis are summited.
